message.text:
I need to identify which concrete code executes the SQL INSERT when a memo is saved under a default installation with no database flags. Multiple database drivers exist, so I will trace the execution path to determine the actual candidate that runs.

I will check the default database driver configuration and locate the concrete CreateMemo method that executes the INSERT.
I'll find the default DB driver and the concrete memo INSERT that runs without database flags.

args.command:
echo "==== profile driver defaults ===="
grep -n -i -E "driver|sqlite|default" /bench/repo/internal/profile/profile.go /bench/repo/cmd/memos/main.go
echo "==== CreateMemo INSERT ===="
grep -n -E "CreateMemo|INSERT INTO.*memo" --include='*.go' -r /bench/repo/store /bench/repo/cmd /bench/repo/internal/profile
